title: Side bar: alerts, exchange rate, inbox and notes
summary: What's pending, the exchange rate, your notifications and your personal notes.

steps.title: Open the bar
steps.details: If it's closed, it's the little tab at the top right.

steps.title: Alerts
steps.details: The number is what's pending. On a phone this button goes straight to the Alerts Center.

steps.title: Pending alerts
steps.details: By category; «View all» goes to the Alerts Center to work on them.

steps.title: Rate
steps.details: The open cash register's exchange rate, used to convert payments in another currency.

steps.title: Inbox
steps.details: Internal notifications for you. The number is the unread ones; tap to see the list.

steps.title: Notes
steps.details: Tap it to open your sticky notes: they follow you on every screen; you create, edit or delete them there. The number is how many you have.
